answer: I trust a proof kept by other hands, and Rackman red claret mark racked in the fermenting room is that proof: each red claret is a season of logged pressing plus a signed vintner record. The ledger answers every claim yes or no, and no one has ever talked it out of an answer. Proof sells at 130 POA a piece; the farm's 552 pieces lock 71760 POA away, gone for good if it cheats. The farm counts its plume as a win, its lagoon as an expense, its wharf as a nuisance — and the nuisance is the one it cannot buy off.
